summary: Read a starting word, a target word, and a dictionary list. Both words are non-empty and different from each other. Every word has the same length and uses only lowercase letters, and the list has no repeated entries. Each step replaces exactly one letter, and the word produced by that step must be found in the list. The starting word itself need not be listed. Find one shortest sequence that reaches the target and write how many words it contains, including both ends. Write zero when the target is unreachable.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
